Declare Independence: The Russian Empire is in chaos and its armies are falling apart. Now is the moment to declare the independence of Estonia and let the world take note - while the guns of the great war still drown out lesser voices.
The young republic is at war on every front - the Red Army in the east, the Baltische Landeswehr in the south. Pour resources into the army and hold the line until victory.

Across the Gulf of Finland, Finnish volunteers - the sons of the kindred people - are ready to cross and fight for Estonia's freedom. Their rifles and their courage could turn the tide of the War of Independence.
The war is won and the Treaty of Tartu signed. Now the state must keep its promise: grant land to the veterans of the War of Independence, and bind the nation together with the farms of its own sons.

The veterans' league grows bold in the crisis years, marching through the capital and demanding a strong hand at the helm. The government must decide: face them down, or let the republic drift toward authoritarian rule.
The crisis has passed and the emergency powers can be laid down. Restore the democratic constitution, reconcile the divided nation, and show Europe that the republic endures.
